hero.title: RAMANOARA Percky
hero.subtitle: Fullstack Web Developer | Lean Management & Project Management Specialist
hero.hook: I build robust web applications and lead projects with the discipline of Lean methods — two different ways to achieve the same goal: a result that works, without waste.

about.title: About
about.p1: I am a fullstack web developer with a background in industrial engineering and a specialization in Lean management. This combination shapes the way I work: I do not just write code that works; I look for the simplest and most effective solution for the team and the user.
about.p2: From developing Moroccan administrative document platforms to leading a Lean project in a textile factory, the common thread is always the same: organize, simplify and deliver a concrete result.

items.title: Fullstack web development
items.desc: I turn an idea into a functional application: interface, business logic, database and deployment. I am equally comfortable starting from scratch or improving an existing platform.

items.title: Lean & continuous improvement
items.desc: I analyze a process, identify what is blocking it and propose concrete solutions (5S, DMAIC). The same method works on a production line and on a software project.

items.title: Project management
items.desc: I break a project into clear steps, track progress and make sure everyone knows what to do — with Agile, Scrum or Kanban.

items.title: Digidoc
items.context: Moroccan platform for managing administrative documents.
items.role: Performance optimization, bug fixing, multilingual integration, interface and admin development.
items.result: A faster and more reliable platform accessible to a multilingual audience.

items.title: Evisa
items.context: A network of platforms for applying for online visas across several countries.
items.role: Performance optimization, mobile interfaces, forms, payment integration and server management.
items.result: Smooth visa application journeys with integrated online payment.

items.title: MiharyKet
items.context: Application built from scratch to connect the members of an agricultural cooperative.
items.role: UML design, agile development, interface and backend implementation, and trigger setup.
items.result: A functional application delivered from design through deployment.

items.title: Project leadership
items.desc: Leading a Lean project independently, from analysis through field implementation.

items.title: Rigor
items.desc: Applying the same standards when debugging a production platform or controlling a process.

items.title: Communication
items.desc: Making a technical idea clear for both a team and a user.

items.title: Problem solving
items.desc: Always understanding the cause before taking action.

items.title: Adaptability
items.desc: Comfortable working across very different fields: visas, administrative documents, agricultural cooperatives and textile manufacturing.

items.title: Continuous improvement
items.desc: The Lean reflex: simplify instead of settling for “it works”.

contact.text: A web project to build, a process to optimize or a team to organize? Let’s talk.
